query.where: portid = 'port664' AND date >= DATE '2021-01-01' AND date <= DATE '2022-12-31'

notes: Rows below are the attributes objects returned by the service, stored verbatim (values unmodified, sorted by date as returned under orderByFields). All 730 calendar days 2021-01-01 to 2022-12-31 are present; no missing dates, no duplicates. Ports-database discovery (same POST discipline, PortWatch_ports_database/FeatureServer/0): portname LIKE '%Los Angeles%' and LIKE '%Long Beach%' both return the single combined entry 'Los Angeles-Long Beach', port664, LOCODE 'US LAX' — the daily layer serves the San Pedro Bay complex only as this combined port. In the graph this portid is carried by sea_losangeles; sea_longbeach has no PortWatch portid (see server/adapters/portwatch_daily.py PORTID_OVERRIDES comment). Import/export figures are IMF PortWatch AIS-estimated metric tons (draught change x deadweight, WP/20/57 method) — class label: SOURCED — PORTWATCH AIS ESTIMATE.
